text:
What is the best among things to be seen, but the serene face of the deer-eyed one?
What is the best among things to be smelled, but the breath from that mouth?
What is the best among things to be heard, but that voice?
What is the best among things to be tasted, but the flavor of those soft lips?
What is the best among things to be touched, but that body?
What is the best among things to be contemplated, but the intoxication of that youthful beauty, shared with kindred hearts, everywhere?
